sources.description: The NFL Draft is next week, and we reached out to old friend James Fragoza to discuss Mountain West football and MW players hoping to get drafted this week. James is an NFL Draft & CFB Analyst for Pro Football & Sports Network, but is always willing to take time for MWCConnection. Read his thoughts […]
